title: Microarray, IPA and GSEA Analysis in Mice Models
author: Stephanie N. Oprescu

steps.title: Isolate RNA from TA muscle
steps.instruction: Dissect tibialis anterior (TA) muscle, weigh, flash‑freeze in liquid nitrogen, add 1 ml TRIzol per 50–100 mg tissue in a 1.5 ml tube, homogenize 2–3 s (2–4 passes) on ice, optionally centrifuge 5 min at 4 °C, 12 000 × g and transfer supernatant (~800 µl), incubate 5 min RT, add 0.2 ml chloroform per 1 ml TRIzol, vortex 15 s, incubate 3 min RT, centrifuge 15 min at 4 °C, 12 000 × g, transfer aqueous phase (≈400–600 µl) to a new tube, add 0.5 ml isopropanol per 1 ml TRIzol, incubate 10 min RT, centrifuge 10 min at 4 °C, 12 000 × g, discard supernatant, wash pellet with 1 ml 75 % ethanol per 1 ml TRIzol, shake briefly, centrifuge 5 min at 4 °C, 7 500 × g, discard supernatant, air‑dry 5–10 min RT, resuspend in 50 µl RNase‑free water.

steps.title: Assess RNA quantity and quality
steps.instruction: Measure RNA concentration and A260/A280 ratio with a NanoDrop; acceptable ratio 1.85–1.95. Verify integrity on an Agilent Bioanalyzer, expecting clear 18S and 28S peaks.

steps.title: Prepare Spike A and B dilution series
steps.instruction: Vortex and heat Spike A and Spike B mixes at 37 °C for 5 min, briefly centrifuge. Dilute Spike A: add 2 µl Spike A to 38 µl dilution buffer (1:20); take 2 µl of that dilution add to 78 µl buffer (1:40); take 2 µl of that add to 30 µl buffer (1:16); take 4 µl of that add to 28 µl buffer (1:8). Add 2 µl of the final dilution (overall 1:102 400) to 25–100 ng RNA (≤3.5 µl). Repeat the same dilution scheme for Spike B.

steps.title: Anneal T7 primer to RNA
steps.instruction: Combine 1.8 µl T7 primer with 1 µl nuclease‑free water per reaction, add 1.8 µl mix to each tube, incubate 65 °C for 10 min with occasional gentle shaking, place on ice 5 min.

steps.title: Synthesize first‑strand cDNA
steps.instruction: Pre‑warm 5× First‑Strand Buffer at 80 °C for 3–4 min, vortex, spin. Assemble on ice: 5× First‑Strand Buffer 2 µl, 0.1 M DTT 1 µl, 10 mM dNTP mix 0.5 µl, Affinity Script RNase Block Mix 1.2 µl (total 4.7 µl). Add this 4.7 µl to each tube containing RNA + Spike mix (final volume 10 µl), mix, incubate 40 °C for 2 h, heat‑inactivate 70 °C for 15 min, place on ice 5 min.

steps.title: Transcribe and label cRNA
steps.instruction: Prepare transcription master mix per reaction: nuclease‑free water 0.75 µl, 5× Transcription buffer 3.2 µl, 0.1 M DTT 0.6 µl, NTP mix 1 µl, T7 RNA Polymerase 0.21 µl, Cyanine 3‑CTP (for Spike A) or Cyanine 5‑CTP (for Spike B) 0.24 µl (final 6 µl). Add 6 µl to each Spike‑RNA tube (now 16 µl total), incubate 40 °C for 2 h.

steps.title: Purify labeled cRNA with RNeasy kit
steps.instruction: Bring each cRNA reaction to 100 µl with nuclease‑free water, add 350 µl RLT, mix, add 250 µl ice‑cold 100 % ethanol, mix, transfer to RNeasy spin column, centrifuge 16 000 × g, 4 °C, 30 s, discard flow‑through, add 500 µl RPE buffer, centrifuge 30 s, repeat wash (30 s), centrifuge 60 s to remove residual buffer, place column in a clean tube, add 30 µl RNase‑free water, incubate RT 1–2 min, centrifuge 16 000 × g, 4 °C, 30 s. Optional re‑elution with additional 30 µl water.

steps.title: Quantify cRNA concentration and purity
steps.instruction: Measure cRNA with NanoDrop ND‑1000 (Microarray Measurement tab, sample type RNA‑40). Record cyanine 3/5 concentration, A260/280 (target 1.9 ± 0.04) and ensure cRNA ≥1.875 µg (for 2‑pack format).

steps.title: Prepare hybridization blocking and fragmentation
steps.instruction: Make 10× blocking agent by adding 1 250 µl nuclease‑free water to the supplied 10× gene expression blocking powder, vortex; if needed heat 37 °C 4–5 min. Assemble fragmentation mix: Cyanine 3‑labeled cRNA 1.875 µg, Cyanine 5‑labeled cRNA 1.875 µg, 10× blocking agent 25 µl, nuclease‑free water to 120 µl, 25× fragmentation buffer 5 µl (final 125 µl). Incubate 60 °C 30 min, place on ice, add equal volume 2× Hi‑RPM Hybridization Buffer, mix gently, spin, keep on ice.

steps.title: Hybridize labeled cRNA to microarray
steps.instruction: Load Agilent SureHyb chamber: add 240 µl hybridization mix to gasket well (left‑to‑right, avoid bubbles), fill any unused wells with 1× Hi‑RPM buffer, place slide (barcode side down, numeric barcode up) onto gasket, cover, clamp, ensure no stationary bubbles. Place chamber on rotator rack in hybridization oven, rotate 10 rpm, incubate 65 °C for 17 h.

steps.title: Wash microarray slides
steps.instruction: Add 2 ml Triton X‑102 to each of Gene Expression Wash Buffers 1 and 2, invert to mix; pre‑warm Wash Buffer 2 to 37 °C. Prepare three staining dishes: Dish 1 – fill with Wash Buffer 1; Dish 2 – place slide rack and magnetic stir bar, fill with Wash Buffer 1; Dish 3 – place stir bar, fill with pre‑warmed Wash Buffer 2 just before use. After hybridization, remove chamber, submerge gasket in Dish 1, pry open with forceps, let gasket drop, transfer slide (numeric barcode up) to rack in Dish 2, stir 1 min; move rack to Dish 3, stir 1 min; remove slides, place on slide holder with active surface up, barcode edge down, close plastic cover.

steps.title: Scan microarray and extract features
steps.instruction: Insert slide holder into scanner cassette, select ‘AgilentG3_HiSen_GX_2color’ protocol, start scan. Open Agilent Feature Extraction software, add scanned images to a new project (default settings), save project as .fep, then start extraction. Perform manual grid mapping if required.

steps.title: Design gene‑specific qPCR primers
steps.instruction: Select candidate genes showing significant microarray changes and a stable reference gene (e.g., 18S rRNA). Design primers yielding amplicons ≤0.6 kb, with similar melting temperatures, minimal secondary structure (use OligoAnalyzer 3.1), and verify specificity by NCBI BLAST or UCSC Genome Browser. Order primers (10 µM stock).

steps.title: Synthesize cDNA for qPCR validation
steps.instruction: Use 1–5 µg total RNA (quality verified). Thaw M‑MLV RT kit, vortex, spin. Assemble on ice (12 µl total): 250 ng random primers 1 µl, 10 mM dNTP mix 1 µl, RNA 1–5 µg, nuclease‑free water to 12 µl. Heat 65 °C 5 min, place on ice. Add 5× First‑Strand Buffer 4 µl, 0.1 M DTT 2 µl, RNaseOUT (40 U/µl) 1 µl, M‑MLV RT 1 µl. Mix, incubate 25 °C 10 min, 37 °C 50 min, heat‑inactivate 70 °C 15 min. Store cDNA at –20 °C.

steps.title: Set up and run real‑time qPCR
steps.instruction: Prepare master mix per 10 µl reaction: FastStart SYBR Green Master 5 µl, forward primer (10 µM) 0.2 µl, reverse primer (10 µM) 0.2 µl, nuclease‑free water 0.6 µl, template cDNA (25 ng/µl) 4 µl. Include 3 biological replicates (different mice) and 3 technical replicates per sample, plus a no‑template control. Run on LightCycler 480 with program: 95 °C 10 min; 35 cycles of 95 °C 10 s, 60 °C 10 s, 72 °C 15 s; melt curve 95 °C 10 s, 65 °C 60 s, ramp to 97 °C at 0.2 °C/s, hold 10 s; cool 30 °C 30 s. Analyze Cq values (discard Cq > 35).
